findings.operativeBite: This artifact exists for race hygiene: its authorityClaim states it takes a new version number because a competing v2 was under independent review and must not be reused. That half is right. But basedOn then misdescribes the disposition of the replacement bytes, which is the other half of the same race. A coordinator reading basedOn would conclude 618cb5be never entered review and requires no disposition. In fact those bytes were dispatched as v2 with a review prompt still on disk, and they now carry an independent Claude 2 ACCEPT frozen at 0444. Recording this artifact on that description would lose track of an issued verdict and of a dispatch — precisely the custody drift the version-number discipline exists to prevent, in the one artifact written to handle a custody incident.
notRescuedBy: The competingV2NotThisSubject entry does not rescue it. That entry is accurate and well-disclosed about b3c91a80, including that its bytes cannot be restored. The defect is in the sibling entry describing 618cb5be.
The absence of a verdict at authoring time does not rescue clause one. The dispatch this clause denies predates the subject.
Being descriptive provenance does not rescue it. basedOn is the artifact's custody surface, and every other entry in it was verified against live bytes and matched.
findings.remedyShape: State the disposition of 618cb5be as it stands. Those bytes were dispatched as v2 — the prompt is on disk — and now carry an independent Claude 2 verdict; whether that verdict is retained, superseded by this v3, or withdrawn is a coordinator act to name, not a fact to deny. A correct entry would record the digest, that a v2 dispatch and a Claude 2 verdict exist against it, and that this v3 supersedes it as the subject under review. This reviewer names no disposition, edits no verdict, and writes no coordinator text.
findings.gradeRationale: Graded SHOULD-FIX and not a blocker because it touches no retained-evidence member, opens no false-pass path on any G12 claim, and leaves the specification's substance — which is byte-identical to bytes already verified against live doctor-contract.v4 — intact. Graded SHOULD-FIX and not advisory because it is a false statement on the custody surface of an artifact whose stated purpose is custody hygiene, and because it bears directly on what the recording act would carry forward.
